title: 45th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/45/2024).
First reading of the Bill amending the Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafushi MP Hussain Riza Adam.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Political Parties Act (Law No. 4/2013), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Bill amending the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Felidhoo MP Adam Zahir.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Bill amending the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kelaa MP Abdulla Shareef.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced a Penal Code amendment bill, began debating the Political Parties Act amendment, and continued debates on the Anti-Corruption Commission and Elections Commission bills.
